rotation_note: rotation is degrees about +Y (Unity yaw): +90 turns the prefab's N door to the east, so canonical N,E,S,W land on E,S,W,N; 180 on S,W,N,E; 270 on W,N,E,S. Each prefab's pivot is its tile centre, +z is its canonical north, floor y = 0, 45 m footprint.
build_note: The Remesh build (2026-10-10): every room composed from Remesh Games' Stylized Dungeon only (its kit Synth/Kit_RemeshStylizedDungeon and set pieces Synth/SetPieces_RemeshStylizedDungeon), 11 themes x 25 at k9 (PrefabSynthesis-remesh, tools/themes_remesh). Each pick keeps the Synty build's door set and rotation (level.picks.json); where the Remesh catalog has the same family and state, it is the same room; otherwise the nearest one in the same state.
